_doc: Brand trademark dictionary. A ™ or ® superscript node is appended after any known product or technology term found in a slide's title, eyebrow, cell-heading-N, or label slots. Terms are matched by substring (e.g. 'Kitchen Station' covers 'Kitchen Station 1', 'Kitchen Station 2', etc.). Extend terms[] when a new trademarked product ships.

titleSuperscriptSpec._note: Used for the 'title' slot only. At 25% of a large title (64px+) the ™ sits in the cap-height zone without Figma's built-in superscript offset.

inlineSuperscriptSpec._note: Used for eyebrow, cell-heading-N, and label slots. At 50% the mark stays readable at smaller base sizes (20–32px).
